criteria.reasoning: The memo says "We cannot apply any portion of the Kestrel grant to this invoice" and "Do not suggest to Peggy that a second Kestrel grant earmarked for the table would work." The reply tells Peggy that "Asking Kestrel to send a second, smaller grant just for the table would not work either."
The memo keeps INV-G26-0112 open "awaiting Peggy's personal payment." The reply asks her to "pay the $3,000 from you and Erik personally — personal check, personal card, or other personal funds."

"Deductible amount = $3,000 − $1,480 = $1,520. The acknowledgment must state the payment, describe the goods and services, give the CFO-approved FMV, include the disclosure and state the resulting deductible amount," under the heading "§6115 / §4.6 disclosure."
The acknowledgment goes "To Kestrel Charitable Trust" and "states the grant amount ($15,000), the date received (2026-09-08), and that no goods or services were provided in exchange."

The memo instructs "Do not reference the SOI in any correspondence with Kestrel Charitable Trust." The Kestrel acknowledgment it describes contains only the amount, date, no-goods-or-services statement, grant ID and the "Studio Wing Campaign" designation. It does not mention the SOI, its balance or the gala.
The reply says "We will not be able to send you a tax receipt" and calls Kestrel "the donor of record for this gift — not you and Erik". It nowhere suggests the grant is deductible to the Halvorsens.

The reply explains that Kestrel "is the donor of record" and that we will be "sending our written acknowledgment to Kestrel". It adds that "any income-tax benefit associated with The Halvorsen Family Fund was received when you and Erik contributed to the fund."
Booking: "Hard credit: Kestrel Charitable Trust... Soft credit: Margaret and Erik Halvorsen... Designation: 'Studio Wing Campaign'... Do not split the gift between the campaign and the gala."
"Apply the full $15,000 to the SOI... the open balance is reduced by the full amount of the grant."
The balance before this grant is $20,000, after the two $10,000 payments; the 2025 gala table is excluded under §4.5. "Open SOI balance after this grant: $5,000."

"The Halvorsens signed the Studio Wing Campaign Statement of Intent on 2024-11-12 on our current form, SW-SOI rev. 2023-02... That form is a non-binding statement of intent under Policy §4.4(1)." It then cites §4.4(1) as allowing the DAF grant to be soft-credited toward it.
